title: The learning evidence loop
summary: How a Project 42 lesson becomes practice, feedback, a transcript entry, and eventually a badge.
description: Progress is more than opening a page. A learner studies a focused lesson, compares an answer with its source, completes a scored check, uses specific feedback to retry when needed, and earns a simulated evidence record only after selecting the supported revision. Repeated module evidence can satisfy path-level badge criteria.
altText: A native interactive flow starts at Learn, moves through Practice and Knowledge check, branches through Feedback and Retry back to Practice when revision is needed, or moves to Transcript when the answer is correct. Free browsing previews every stage, but the Transcript remains pending until a supported answer is selected. Earned module evidence contributes to a Path, and a simulated Badge becomes available only when every criterion in the demo path is complete.
caption: Project 42 turns study into evidence through source comparison, practice, scored feedback, revision, simulated transcript records, and path-level badge criteria.
takeaways: Feedback is part of the learning loop, not a terminal failure.
Transcript entries represent completed evidence, not page views or stage browsing.
Badges summarize mastery across a complete path.
safetyNotice: This fictional demonstration keeps state only in this browser component. It does not write a learner record, transcript entry, credential, or achievement.

pendingRecord.label: Pending simulated evidence preview
pendingRecord.title: Demo module evidence is not yet earned
pendingRecord.body: Free browsing can preview this stage, but no completed or verified evidence exists yet. Return to the knowledge check and select the supported revision to earn the simulated local record.

earnedRecord.label: Earned simulated evidence record
earnedRecord.title: Demo module evidence
earnedRecord.body: This record was earned by selecting the supported revision. It exists only inside this demonstration.
earnedRecord.evidenceValue: Supported revision selected after source comparison
earnedRecord.persistenceValue: Not saved and not sent to a platform service

nodes.label: Learn
nodes.heading: Distinguish source support from an unsupported assertion
nodes.description: Read the supplied source closely. A source supports only what it actually states. An answer becomes unsupported when it adds a broader conclusion that the source does not establish.

nodes.label: Practice
nodes.heading: Compare the answer with the source
nodes.description: Identify which part of the learner answer goes beyond the supplied source. Pay attention to the difference between one fictional pilot group and every team.

nodes.label: Knowledge check
nodes.heading: Which revision is supported by the supplied source?
nodes.description: Choose one answer. An incorrect choice opens specific feedback and a retry route. The supported choice earns a simulated transcript record.

nodes.label: Feedback
nodes.heading: Use specific feedback
nodes.description: The selected answer is not yet acceptable. Compare the feedback with the source before beginning the retry.

action.label: Use feedback and prepare a retry

nodes.label: Retry
nodes.heading: Return to practice with a narrower claim
nodes.description: Revise by retaining only details established by the source. Do not turn a result from one fictional pilot group into a statement about every team.

nodes.label: Transcript
nodes.heading: Review the simulated module evidence
nodes.description: Before a correct response, this stage is only a pending preview. Selecting the supported answer completes this demonstration module and earns the simulated local evidence record. Nothing is written to a real transcript.

nodes.label: Path
nodes.heading: Distinguish one module from a complete path
nodes.description: The current module supplies one criterion only after the supported answer is selected. The separately completed demo modules supply the other criteria. A path is complete only when every listed criterion is complete.

nodes.label: Badge
nodes.heading: Evaluate the simulated path badge
nodes.description: The badge is a local demonstration state, not a platform credential. It is available only when all demo-path criteria are complete.

artifacts.title: Fictional pilot note
artifacts.body: In a four-week internal writing pilot, the documentation team asked participants to mark claims that were not supported by the provided passages. The note reports that the participating group identified more unsupported claims in its final exercise than in its first exercise. The note does not describe other teams or organization-wide results.
artifacts.attribution: Fictional instructional example written for this guide. It is not a report of a real study or organization.

artifacts.label: Specific feedback
artifacts.title: Why the assertion is unsupported
artifacts.body: The source discusses only the participating documentation group and compares its first and final exercises. It does not provide evidence about every team, and it does not establish the broad conclusion expressed by the word “proves.”

artifacts.label: Corrected answer
artifacts.title: Supported revision
artifacts.body: The fictional note reports that the participating documentation group identified more unsupported claims in its final exercise than in its first exercise.

artifacts.label: Demo path summary

artifacts.body: Two fictional modules are supplied as separately completed examples. The current module changes from pending to complete only after the supported answer is selected.
